item.tib: dus bzhi rgyal mo'i zhus len
item.coloph: de skad gsungs nas bud med bzhi/ mkha' la gzha' ltar yal nas thal/ 'di bris dge ba'i mthu dpal gyi bdag cag phyi rabs gang zags rnams/ sems nyid skye med don rtogs nas/ rang sems zad med gter spyod shog kha ba can ljongs bod yul du/ 'phrul ngag bden pa'i g.yung drung bon/ dar rgyas brtan pa'i bkra shis shog/
